name: qwen3
what: Chat template of Qwen3 (ChatML turns with <think> reasoning blocks).

upstream.license_evidence: LICENSE file in the repository at this revision (Apache License 2.0, appendix filled in as Copyright 2024 Alibaba Cloud) and the card's license: apache-2.0

checks: Byte-identical to upstream: the chat_template field of tokenizer_config.json (JSON-decoded) in Qwen/Qwen3-8B at revision b968826d9c46 equals the text (go run ./tools/feedbuild upstream re-checks it). Last checked 2026-10-14.

Socair's chat-template check (defilantech/socair@ddfe650b5f50, the RealTemplates corpus gate, 2026-10-14): PASS, with no code reach and no content-conditional injection; rendered 6 of 6 probe conversations; text it adds of its own: Hermes-style tool-call instructions when tools are given; nothing is added under a content condition.
notes: ChatML layout with no default system prompt. Two conditions read message text, and both remove or move text rather than add it: an assistant message containing </think> is split into reasoning and answer, and user messages wrapped in <tool_response> tags are skipped when finding the last real query. Writes <think> blocks for assistant turns after the last query, and an empty <think></think> at the generation prompt when enable_thinking is false. Tools are written as JSON in the system turn, as in Qwen2.5.

review.means: A person read the whole template text at the pinned revision and confirmed that it only lays out the conversation it is given: it adds no instruction to the model beyond the publisher's own default system prompt and tool scaffolding, no branch adds text when a message contains a particular string, and it reaches nothing but the documented chat-template variables and filters. Byte identity with the upstream file and Socair's chat-template check are mechanical checks, listed under checks; they are not the review.
